svg.title: ESP32-S3 temperature monitor LCD UI vector mockups
svg.desc: Native editable SVG of two read-only 240 by 320 LCD screens, overview and trends, plus Wi-Fi setup state. Sensor status legend and web configurable settings included.

g.text: Durations are configured in the web application
Sensor states — examples displayed on the overview
Warnings are indicated by color AND an icon/text state; missing/unassigned sensors do not raise alarms.
● Red: high alert ● Gray: lost or disabled
All 5 readings fit; no touch, buttons or menus.
Disconnected alerts do not block other readings.
5 named probes + current temperatures + individual warnings
Wi-Fi status shown on overview; local clock via SNTP/NTP
After NTP sync, time continues while the device remains powered
Trends are 5 small read-only sparklines; history source is shared
Basic / Extended mode; 20 s / 10 s durations
Sensor names, enabled state and alerts
